svg.title: An empty free list starts a bounded allocation progress loop, not an infinite wait
svg.desc: A cold miss needs a frame. Allocation first takes a BCB from the invalid list. If that list is empty it searches for a victim through the thread's own private LRU list when over quota, other private lists, the shared lists, and finally its own private list as a fallback; a found victim is reused after the final protected recheck. If nothing is eligible and the page-flush daemon is available, the thread joins the direct-victim waiter queue with high or low priority, wakes the page-flush daemon, and sleeps with a timed wait. It may resume with an assigned BCB that is revalidated and retried if fixed again, be interrupted, or time out. Without a daemon the thread flushes synchronously and searches again. If no BCB can be produced and no earlier error is set, the allocation reports the all-buffers-dirty error. Every path ends in an assignment, a retry, an interrupt, a timeout, or an explicit error.
svg.text: No free BCB: the allocation progress loop and its exits
Cold miss needs a frame for one VPID
1. Invalid (free) list
BCBs nobody uses; no flush or recheck needed.
Found: reuse at once
no wait, no victim search
empty
2. Victim search across LRU lists
own private list if it is over quota,
then other private lists, then shared lists,
then own private list as a last fallback.
Found: victimize
after the final protected eligibility recheck
nothing eligible now
3a. Flush daemon available (server)
Join the direct-victim waiter queue: high priority
for vacuum or a holder of a hot page with waiters,
otherwise low priority. Wake the page-flush
daemon. Sleep with the latch timeout.
producers: victim flush, post-flush,
LRU direct assignment, vacuum unfix in LRU3
Resumed with an assigned BCB
revalidate under the BCB mutex; fixed again?
revoked: retry, now with high priority
Interrupt or shutdown
un-assign any BCB; ER_INTERRUPTED; no frame
Timeout
the wait ends with an error and no frame
3b. No daemon (SA mode, recovery)
Flush synchronously, then search
the LRU lists again.
expected to find a victim on the second pass
Still no BCB and no earlier error: ER_PB_ALL_BUFFERS_DIRTY
The allocator reports the error and the fix returns without a page pointer.
Every path ends in an assignment,
a retry, an interrupt, a timeout,
or an explicit error. The source's own
comment says a waiter depends on
producers; fairness and starvation
bounds are not proved for this loop.
